title: Cisco CP-9951 DOOM — Engine MVP
summary: Smallest end-to-end reference scene for the reusable Source2Reel engine.

scenes.title: CISCO CP-9951 // DOOM v.666
scenes.narration: This is a Cisco office phone. And yes, it really runs Doom. The game executes locally on the phone, renders to its framebuffer, and uses the physical Cisco controls.
scenes.notes: Reference MVP: authentic evidence remains static for the complete scene.
